name: Sivi
testimonial:
Well, firstly, Ma’am is simply one of a kind. You always made our class time fun and energetic, as well as just making everyone happy.

Ma’am also has a wide range in terms of humour, which is really awesome!

You also used your own knowledge to give us more information about each topic because, as Ma’am said, “The textbooks sucked”, and I felt that that helped all of us with our exams. Especially those study lessons before the exam where we went over EVERYTHING again, but Ma’am had a way of making it not feel repetitive. It felt like everything was bright, colourful and new even though we were doing revisions.

Overall, we all really, really miss you Ma’am and are extremely grateful for our time together, the lessons Ma’am taught and just the energy that Ma’am always brought with her.
